note: Five independently researched business-role examples; not exhaustive utilities membership. No weights, historical membership, capacity forecast achievement or quantified theme revenue inferred.
comparison_note: Generation, distribution, transmission assets, equipment manufacturing and power trading differ in regulation, asset intensity and revenue recognition. This is a value-chain map, not a homogeneous valuation peer group.

members.rationale: NTPC describes conventional and renewable electricity generation. Diversification and future capacity targets are not treated as commissioned assets or current renewable revenue share.
members.identity_source: Current official Nifty constituent archive; not historical membership

members.rationale: Torrent Power describes an integrated generation, transmission and distribution business. Distribution exposure is not pure-play revenue, and service areas are not assumed to be owned land or monopoly rights everywhere.
members.identity_source: Current official Nifty constituent archive; not historical membership

members.rationale: Power Grid documents electricity transmission assets and HVDC links. Transmission infrastructure is distinct from electricity generation or equipment manufacturing; no current asset-base growth inferred.
members.identity_source: Current official Nifty constituent archive; not historical membership
members.company: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd.

members.rationale: ABB India reports electrification and motion business activity. This is listed-company equipment exposure adjacent to utilities, not ownership of the utilities supplied or all global ABB business.
members.identity_source: Current official Nifty constituent archive; not historical membership

members.rationale: PTC India describes licensed trading of power. Electricity trading is distinct from a power exchange and from generation capacity; traded volumes are not net revenue or company-owned output.
